subject_description: a hulking berserker knight in black spiked plate armor with a horned helm, a torn red cape and a gigantic jagged black greatsword
initial_pose: standing side-on facing right, the gigantic greatsword resting on his right shoulder, blade pointing back
description: a heavy chain throw with his LEFT arm while the gigantic greatsword stays resting on his right shoulder: he winds his left arm back, whips it forward and flings the chain wrapped round his left forearm straight out to the right, the arm fully stretched out, holds it for a beat, then yanks it back hard toward his body, leaning back with the pull, and settles into the standing pose. Only a short length of chain hangs from his left hand. Side view facing right in every frame. No effects, no swoosh, no dust, no smoke, no motion trails.
